title: Review of c03's FCH gated micelles: SIBWD replicates on a fresh seed, but a shell-free twin with uniformly lowered cargo D (0.003) holds the cargo as well (24x vs 27x)
summary: Fresh seed 17 (T=400): ~29 micelles from white noise, each with a shell-q ring (rim/core 9.9, rim/outside 5.0, 242/248 membrane-like), 24 persistent splits to generation 3 with no merges, cargo 27x the outside at t=400 and >= 2x in 97-100% of bodies; fissions pinch the ring into two rings, with a visible cargo leak between siblings. As a beyond-diffusion check I ran the world with no gate (beta=0) and the cargo diffusivity lowered uniformly: Dc=0.03 keeps >= 2x in 98-100% of bodies (contrast 3.8x at t=400), and Dc=0.003 gives 24x at t=400 with >= 2x in 98-100%, the same as the gated world, with identical bodies and splits. The shell also floods the medium: q outside rises 0.08 to 0.37 by t=400, so the gate lowers the cargo D about 20x everywhere, not only at the ring. The gate passes the rubric's W control (beta=0 gives 1.1x) but a self-made cargo is held as well by slow diffusion alone.

controls_run.W: lowD_0.003/seed17 and lowD_0.03/seed17 (beta=0, cargo Dc lowered uniformly 300x and 33x, no gate): cargo still >= 2x in 98-100% of bodies; 24x at Dc=0.003 against 27x gated

verdicts.limitation: The containment is matched by a uniformly lowered cargo diffusivity with no shell at all (Dc=0.003: 24x vs 27x, same bodies and splits), as c01 found for the earlier self-made-cargo worlds: a cargo made inside the body with slow decay is held by slow diffusion alone, so the shell's work is not beyond diffusion. The shell q never reaches steady state and floods the medium (outside q 0.08 to 0.37), which lowers the cargo D about 20x everywhere by t=400. One seed, T=400, no dt or resolution check of my own. A test that would separate gate from slow D: a uniform external cargo source (as in c01's uptake world) or a fast-mixing interior with the cargo made in one spot.
